content:
elaine: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. RCA is live here: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-451. Short summary: cache eviction storm + shard throttling created localized router run-queue buildup -> increased tail latency and request timeouts.

elaine: New action items (assignments in thread):\n• maya - expand runbook with 'cache-eviction' section + emergency rollback steps
• raj - create high-priority alert `router_runq_p99` and wire pager on pagerduty
• jonathan - add CI synthetic that simulates prefix/KV eviction and measures warm-start latency
• liz - draft short-term infra mitigation (router cpu/request bump + pod spread) and cost estimate
• sam - prepare customer-facing note for affected Dedicated tenants + support FAQ
• nina - review retention of logs & PII in eviction traces
• eng-oncall - verify cross-region fallback and failover playbook

raj: Taking the alert. Quick ask: should the alert be a ratio-based or absolute threshold? I can start with p99 > 200ms for 5m. :thinking:

elaine: Start with absolute p99 > 250ms for 5m and include a change-note in the alert describing mitigation steps. We'll iterate.

nina: I'll do a quick sweep of logs tomorrow and flag anything that looks like customer data in traces. ETA EOD.

maya: I'll open the runbook PR with a checklist for 'cache-busting' deploys: pause background evictors, drain-warm-start traffic, stepdown plan. PR link when ready.

jonathan: I'll prototype the synthetic test as a nightly job that forces a controlled eviction and then measures q95/q99. Will post the job link in this thread: https://phab.redwood/T5678

liz: Short-term mitigation idea: for the warm path, increase router CPU request to 1.5vCPU and add anti-affinity. Longer-term: smarter eviction backoff. I'll sketch an RFC + cost delta by Thu.

sam: For comms, can someone export the tenant list affected? Support can compile the list and I'll draft an email. Also should we offer credits?

elaine: Support will export the list. On credits: let's discuss with sales + legal before promising. @sam please loop them in after draft.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: `fix/router-backpressure-2026-03` — canary started (us-east-1, 4/8 routers). See CI: https://ci.redwood/build/8921

sam: After canary passes, please hold and run jonathan's synthetic before wide rollout. We want to validate the warm path.

elaine: Agreed: canary -> synthetic validation -> full rollout. Also scheduling a 30-min postmortem sync for SRE+Infra+Platform tomorrow 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite.

raj: One more ask for leadership: should we change shard-rollout canary default? 15m felt short for anything touching cache or shard state.

elaine: Good point. Let's set canary default to 45m for shard/cache altering rollouts. I'll update rollout policy doc and notify release-eng.

maya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/499. It includes play-by-play and rollback snippets. Tagging `eng-oncall` for review.

jonathan: Added initial synthetic job script to phab ticket. I'll attach latency graphs after first run.

liz: RFC WIP: will include autoscale rule suggestion if router_runq_p95 exceeds 0.6 for 3m. That should reduce human ops time.

sam: Draft comms will be posted in 3 hours for review.\n
elaine: Thanks all. Please update the action tracker at https://tracker.redwood/actions?filter=INC-2026-451 when tasks are complete. If you have SLA/billing questions, DM me and I'll pull in Sales. Closing thread for the all-hands follow-up. :thumbsup:
